================================================================================
BundlerGuchhoJSON.BuildFormatUMD
---------- /out.js ----------
(function(global, factory) {
  typeof exports === "object" && typeof module !== "undefined" ? module.exports = factory(require) :
  typeof define === "function" && define.amd ? define(["require"], factory) :
  (global = typeof globalThis !== "undefined" ? globalThis : global || self, factory(void 0));
})(this , function(require) {
  // app.js
  var app_exports = {};
  __export(app_exports, {
    answer: () => answer
  });
  var answer = 42;
  console.log(answer);
  return __toCommonJS(app_exports);
});

================================================================================
BundlerGuchhoJSON.BuildFormatUMDWithExternal
---------- /out.js ----------
(function(global, factory) {
  typeof exports === "object" && typeof module !== "undefined" ? module.exports = factory(require, require("vue")) :
  typeof define === "function" && define.amd ? define(["require", "vue"], factory) :
  (global = typeof globalThis !== "undefined" ? globalThis : global || self, factory(void 0, global.vue));
})(this , function(require, dep0) {
  // app.js
  var app_exports = {};
  __export(app_exports, {
    app: () => app
  });
  var import_vue = __require("vue");
  var app = (0, import_vue.create)();
  return __toCommonJS(app_exports);
});

================================================================================
BundlerGuchhoJSON.BuildFormatUMDWithGlobalName
---------- /out.js ----------
(function(global, factory) {
  typeof exports === "object" && typeof module !== "undefined" ? module.exports = factory(require) :
  typeof define === "function" && define.amd ? define(["require"], factory) :
  (global = typeof globalThis !== "undefined" ? globalThis : global || self, (global.MyLib = global.MyLib || {}, global.MyLib = factory(void 0)));
})(this , function(require) {
  // app.js
  var app_exports = {};
  __export(app_exports, {
    answer: () => answer
  });
  var answer = 42;
  console.log(answer);
  return __toCommonJS(app_exports);
});

BundlerGuchhoJSON.BuildSplittingEmitsSharedChunk
---------- /out/a.js ----------

  shared
} from "./chunk-SOQI7MIY.js";

// a.js
console.log(shared);

---------- /out/b.js ----------
import {
  shared
} from "./chunk-SOQI7MIY.js";

// b.js
console.log(shared);

---------- /out/chunk-SOQI7MIY.js ----------
// shared.js
var shared = 123;

export {
  shared
};
